lastCompletedGameRecap.recapHeadline: Dak Prescott accounts for 5 TDs as the Cowboys roll to a 51-30 victory over the Titans
lastCompletedGameRecap.recapLeadExcerpt: ARLINGTON, Texas -- — When one touchdown became two and three and so on, all the way to six, Dak Prescott said the conversation was the same for the offense of the Dallas Cowboys : Just keeping doing it.  So they did.  Prescott threw four touchdown passes and ran for a score, and the Cowboys reached the end zone on their first six drives while scoring on all eight possessions before kneeling once at the end of a 51-30 victory over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.  “It was just constant communication all game from all 11 of us, or whoever’s in the game, of keep pushing it, ‘We did it. This time it was in the Dallas play-calling debut of veteran coach Mike Pettine , who took over those duties from 34-year-old Christian Parker , the youngest defensive coordinator in club history.  Parker was essentially demoted after a 46-40 loss to San Francisco in which the Cowboys gave up the most yards in a home game in franchise history (584).
lastCompletedGameRecap.inGameInjuryNotes: Injuries Titans: S Tony Adams was ruled out in the first half due to an illness. ... CB Cor'Dale Flott (neck), S Terrell Burgess (knee) and LT Dan Moore Jr . (knee) were all hurt during the game. Cowboys: CB DaRon Bland (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Saturday. ... LB Dee Winters injured a knee in the second quarter and didn't return.
lastCompletedGameRecap.upNextNotes: Up next Titans: At Jacksonville next Sunday. Cowboys: Home against Philadelphia on Thanksgiving Day.

coachingMatchup.headline: Robert Saleh & DC Gus Bradley vs. HC Liam Coen, OC Grant Udinski & DC Anthony Campanile (Road Test)
coachingMatchup.summary: Week 12 two-sided coordinator chess match pitting Tennessee Titans's staff (Robert Saleh, OC Brian Daboll, DC Gus Bradley) against Jacksonville Jaguars (7-3)—testing both Tennessee's offensive efficiency and its defensive pass-rush and coverage discipline.
bullets: Pass-Game Efficiency & Coverage Shell Delta: Robert Saleh and OC Brian Daboll pair condensed splits with pre-snap jet motion and orbit motion to stress Jacksonville Jaguars's single-high vs. two-high rotations—widening curl/flat defenders to attack the honey-hole between hook/curl linebackers and deep safeties on play-action choice/dagger concepts.

Trench Run-Fit & Two-Way Leverage: Against Jacksonville Jaguars's pin-and-pull, counter, and duo runs targeting the A- and B-gaps, DC Gus Bradley balances four-man pressure with disguised Quarters and Cover 6 split-safety rotations on early downs and in the red zone.

Money-Down & Red-Zone Execution: Third-down conversion discipline and red-zone touchdown rate govern whether Tennessee sustains multi-play scoring drives or yields momentum to Jacksonville Jaguars's pass rush and coverage disguises.
Tempo, Turnovers & Venue Leverage: Road Test situational play-calling, penalty margin, and turnover differential provide the clearest late-game swing factors for both coaching staffs.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Cam Ward, Gunnar Helm & Carnell Tate vs. S Jessie Bates III & LB Foyesade Oluokun
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: TEN: #26 Pass Off (182.6 yds) · #23 Off. Scoring (-1.83) | JAX: #3 Pass Def (-3.58)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Cam Ward, Gunnar Helm & Carnell Tate attack the intermediate seams and middle-of-the-field leverage windows against Jacksonville Jaguars's #3 pass defense (-3.58). Winning early-down timing throws keeps Tennessee's offense ahead of the chains and punishes disguised single-high rotations.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Cam Ward (#1) scanning Jaguars's deep safeties at the snap—when LB Foyesade Oluokun widens to take away the crossers, the intermediate seam opens immediately for Gunnar Helm (#84).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Jermaine Johnson II, Jacob Martin & John Franklin-Myers vs. QB Trevor Lawrence & G Emmanuel Pregnon
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: TEN: #16 Def Sacks (2.3/gm) | JAX: #16 Pass Protection (6.5%)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Jermaine Johnson II, Jacob Martin & John Franklin-Myers lead Tennessee's #16 NFL pass rush (2.3/gm) against Jacksonville Jaguars's #16 pass-protection unit (6.5%). Collapsing the interior pocket without sending extra blitzers lets Titans keep seven defenders in coverage.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: On 3rd-and-6+, watch whether Jermaine Johnson II (#11) draw chip help from Jaguars's tight ends or backs—creating 1-on-1 rush lanes inside for Jacob Martin (#57).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Anthony Hill Jr., Joshua Williams & Kevin Winston Jr. vs. WR Travis Hunter & QB Trevor Lawrence
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: TEN: #32 Pass Def (+7.94) | JAX: #10 Pass Off (244.7 yds)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Anthony Hill Jr., Joshua Williams & Kevin Winston Jr. anchor Tennessee's #32 pass defense (+7.94) against WR Travis Hunter and Jacksonville Jaguars's #10 passing attack (244.7 yds). Limiting explosive 20+ yard chunk plays forces Jaguars into sustained red-zone drives.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Track Anthony Hill Jr. (#53) at the top of routes against WR Travis Hunter: press-bail alignment with safety help over the top takes away QB Trevor Lawrence's preferred isolation shots.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Tony Pollard & Elic Ayomanor vs. Jaguars Front Seven & LB Foyesade Oluokun
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: TEN: #23 Rush Off (102.7 yds) | JAX: #1 Rush Def (-2.28)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Tony Pollard & Elic Ayomanor test Jacksonville Jaguars's #1 run defense (-2.28) with horizontal stretch and interior cutback lanes. Generating 4.5+ yards on first down unlocks play-action explosives and neutralizes Jaguars's pass-rush packages.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch whether Jaguars's linebackers over-pursue motion to the perimeter—opening decisive backside B-gap cutback lanes for Tony Pollard (#20).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Atonio Mafi, Austin Schlottmann & Chandler Zavala vs. DE Travon Walker & Jaguars Simulated Pressures
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: TEN: #16 Pass Protection (6.0%) | JAX: #16 Def Sacks (2.4/gm)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Atonio Mafi, Austin Schlottmann & Chandler Zavala protect Cam Ward (#16 protection at 6.0%) against DE Travon Walker and Jacksonville Jaguars's #16 pass rush (2.4/gm). Passing off interior twists and simulated blitzes cleanly determines late-down conversion efficiency.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Atonio Mafi (#70) on obvious passing downs—if DE Travon Walker cannot win clean around the arc, Jaguars must dial up interior stunts that stress Austin Schlottmann (#51).
